name: Chicken Breast
siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO as it provides no fermentable carbohydrates. Well-tolerated in all phases of SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil, oregano, or thyme
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Grill, bake, or sauté with low-FODMAP vegetables
Avoid marinades containing onion, garlic, or high-FODMAP ingredients
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially niacin and B6
Good source of phosphorus and selenium
Low in saturated fat when skinless
